56247-catty-atkins.title: Catty Atkins
56247-catty-atkins.creator: Clarence Budington Kelland
56247-catty-atkins.description: A book by Clarence Budington Kelland. I knew right off there must be something wrong with that gun. It was the very first time I’d ever shot it, and if a gun don’t shoot straight the first time, when it’s spang-whang _new_, what kind of shooting will it do when it gets to be old and worn? I was dog-gone disappointed.

arxiv-2011-05101.title: Involutive Moving Frames II; The Lie-Tresse theorem
arxiv-2011-05101.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by . This paper continues the project, begun in [ 1 ] , of harmonizing Cartan’s classical equivalence method and the modern equivariant moving frame in a framework dubbed involutive moving frames . As an attestation of the fruitfulness of our framework, we obtain a new, constructive and intuitive proof of the Lie-Tresse theorem (Fundamental basis theorem) and a first general upper bound on the minimal number of generating differential invariants for Lie pseudo-groups.

arxiv-2105-00412.title: TE-ESN: Time Encoding Echo State Network for Prediction Based on Irregularly Sampled Time Series Data
arxiv-2105-00412.creator: Chenxi Sun, Shenda Hong, Moxian Song, Yanxiu Zhou, Yongyue Sun, Derun Cai, Hongyan Li
arxiv-2105-00412.description: Abstract Prediction based on Irregularly Sampled Time Series (ISTS) is of wide concern in the real-world applications. For more accurate prediction, the methods had better grasp more data characteristics. Different from ordinary time series, ISTS is characterised with irregular time intervals of intra-series and different sampling rates of inter-series.

arxiv-2112-14062.title: Neutrino Observations of LHAASO Sources: Present Constraints and Future Prospects 2021 Neutrino Observations of LHAASO Sources: Present Constraints and Future Prospects – B
arxiv-2112-14062.creator: Tian-Qi Huang, Zhuo Li
arxiv-2112-14062.description: Abstract The Large High Altitude Air Shower Observatory (LHAASO) observed a dozen of gamma-ray sources with significant emission above 100 TeV, which may be strong candidates of PeVatrons. Neutrino observations are crucial to diagnose whether the gamma-ray radiative process is hadronic or leptonic.

arxiv-2307-14736.title: Fodor and Pylyshyn’s Critique of Connectionism and the Brain as Basis of the Mind
arxiv-2307-14736.creator: Christoph von der Malsburg
arxiv-2307-14736.description: Abstract To this day there is no satisfactory answer to the question how mental patterns correspond to physical states of our brain. For more than six decades, progress has been held up by the logjam between two traditions, one inspired by neuroscience, the other by digital computing.

arxiv-2411-16497.title: Stacking-dependent electronic structure of ultrathin perovskite bilayers
arxiv-2411-16497.creator: Daniel T. Larson, Daniel Bennett, Abduhla Ali, Anderson S. Chaves, Raagya Arora, Karin M. Rabe, Efthimios Kaxiras
arxiv-2411-16497.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Daniel T. Larson, Daniel Bennett, Abduhla Ali, Anderson S. Chaves, Raagya Arora, Karin M. Rabe, Efthimios Kaxiras. Twistronics has received much attention as a new method to manipulate the properties of 2D van der Waals structures by introducing moiré patterns through a relative rotation between two layers. Here we begin a theoretical exploration of twistronics beyond the realm of van der Waals materials by developing a first-principles description of the electronic structure and interlayer interactions of ultrathin perovskite bilayers.

britannica-1911-barras-paul-francois-nic.title: Barras, Paul François Nicolas (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)

pmc-10493197.title: Practice of Pre-Hospital Emergency Care and Associated Factors in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia: Facility-Based Cross-Sectional Study Design
pmc-10493197.creator: Azanaw Abebe, Zegeye Kebede, Dereje Bayissa Demissie
pmc-10493197.description: BackgroundMedical emergencies require quick field interventions and stabilization before transport, while rapid transportation to definitive healthcare with fewer field interventions improves trauma outcomes. Poor prehospital healthcare practices negatively impact patients’ health, and limited studies exist on providers’ practices in resource-limited areas like Ethiopia.

pmc-10550014.title: Disseminated Histoplasmosis Presenting as Obstructive Jaundice
pmc-10550014.creator: Laith Numan, Wail A. Hayajneh, Wissam Kiwan
pmc-10550014.description: Gastrointestinal manifestations in systemic fungal infection are not uncommon; however, obstructive jaundice due to lymphadenopathy is considered rare. We present a case of a 16-year-old male patient who presented with painless jaundice. Laboratory tests revealed direct hyperbilirubinemia with cholestatic liver injury.

pmc-10626854.title: Cost-effectiveness analysis of the Geriatric Fracture Center (GFC) concept: a prospective multicentre cohort study
pmc-10626854.creator: Alexander Joeris, Sheila Sprague, Michael Blauth, Markus Gosch, Pannida Wattanapanom, Rahat Jarayabhand, Martijn Poeze, Merng K Wong, Ernest B K Kwek, Johannes H Hegeman, Carlos Perez-Uribarri, Enrique Guerado, Thomas J Revak, Sebastian Zohner, David Joseph, Mark R Phillips
pmc-10626854.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). IntroductionGeriatric Fracture Centers (GFCs) are dedicated treatment units where care is tailored towards elderly patients who have suffered fragility fractures. The primary objective of this economic analysis was to determine the cost-utility of GFCs compared with usual care centres.MethodsThe primary analysis was a cost-utility analysis that measured the cost per incremental quality-adjusted life-year gained from treatment of hip fracture in GFCs compared with treatment in usual care centres from the societal perspective over a 1-year time horizon.

pmc-10740974.title: Decreased FXR Agonism in the Bile Acid Pool Is Associated with Impaired FXR Signaling in a Pig Model of Pediatric NAFLD
pmc-10740974.creator: Magdalena A Maj, Douglas G Burrin, Rodrigo Manjarín, Gian Paolo Caviglia, Davide Giuseppe Ribaldone
pmc-10740974.description: The objective of this study was to investigate whether the impairment of farnesoid X receptor (FXR)-fibroblast growth factor 19 (FGF19) signaling in juvenile pigs with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is associated with changes in the composition of the enterohepatic bile acid pool.

pmc-11257068.title: Should I Take Aspirin? (SITA): randomised controlled trial of a decision aid for cancer chemoprevention
pmc-11257068.creator: Shakira R Onwuka, Jennifer McIntosh, Finlay Macrae, Patty Chondros, Lucy Boyd, Rushani Wijesuriya, Sibel Saya, Napin Karnchanachari, Kitty Novy, Mark A Jenkins, Fiona M Walter, Lyndal Trevena, Javiera Martinez Gutierrez, Kate Broun, George Fishman, Julie Marker, Jon Emery
pmc-11257068.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundAustralian guidelines recommend that people aged 50–70 years consider taking low-dose aspirin to reduce their risk of colorectal cancer (CRC).AimTo determine the effect of a consultation with a researcher before an appointment in general practice using a decision aid presenting the benefits and harms of taking low-dose aspirin compared with a general CRC prevention brochure on patients’ informed decision making and low-dose aspirin use.Design and settingIndividually randomised controlled trial in six general practices in Victoria, Australia, from October 2020 to March 2021.MethodParticipants

pmc-11392451.title: Short-Term Follow-up of Surgical Management Verruca Vulgaris with Modified Estlander Flap: A Case Report and Recent Literature Review
pmc-11392451.creator: Mohammad Gazali, Muhammad Ruslin, Carolina Stevanie, Andi-Sitti-Hajrah Yusuf, Aisha A. H. Al-Jamaei, Paolo Boffano, Tymour Forouzanfar, Kei Tomihara
pmc-11392451.description: BackgroundVerruca vulgaris (VV), widely known as warts, is a common benign skin lesion, which is caused by human papilloma virus. In some cases, VV can be developed within the oral cavity. Surgical excision is considered as the most preferred treatment modality for both cutaneous and oral VV which could be challenge to deal with.

pmc-11551391.title: Metabolic engineering of Corynebacterium glutamicum for the production of pyrone and pyridine dicarboxylic acids
pmc-11551391.creator: Jae Sung Cho, Zi Wei Luo, Cheon Woo Moon, Cindy Pricilia Surya Prabowo, Sang Yup Lee
pmc-11551391.description: SignificanceExploration into alternative plastic monomers to replace petrochemical-derived monomers has been limited due to production challenges. One promising class of potential alternatives is pseudoaromatic compounds. This study presents the sustainable production of five pseudoaromatic dicarboxylic acids using metabolically engineered Corynebacterium glutamicum strains directly from glucose.

pmc-11678737.title: Disentangling Taxonomic Confusions in the Aporia agathon Group Using Mitochondrial Genomic Data (Lepidoptera: Pieridae)
pmc-11678737.creator: Shao-Ji Hu, Ya-Qi Jia, Xin Zhang, Yu-Feng Hsu, Alexander L Monastyrskii, Van Lien Vu, Si-Xun Ge, Kuang Duan, Zhuo-Heng Jiang, Valerio Sbordoni, Min Wang, David G James
pmc-11678737.description: Simple SummaryAn updated classification system for the Aporia agathon group is proposed after the re-examination of a long series of specimens with mitogenomic data. Our results showed that A. japfuensis, A. bifurcata, A. moltrechti, A. kuangtungensis, and A. omotoi should be recognised as full species, while lemoulti, gigantea, and fanjinensis should be recognized as subspecies of A. largeteaui.

pmc-12444340.title: Local excision in rectal cancer: When and for whom?
pmc-12444340.creator: Semra Demirli Atici, Aras Emre Canda, Mustafa Cem Terzi
pmc-12444340.description: Local excision (LE) is an effective treatment option for rectal cancer that shows significant regression following neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy. Compared to traditional total mesorectal excision (TME), LE can achieve comparable oncological outcomes while preserving function and improving quality of life (QoL). The indications for LE have been gradually expanded, but there are uncertainties regarding postoperative oncological results.

pmc-12492761.title: The effect of educational intervention using surgery preference cards on anxiety and clinical competence among operating room nursing students in general surgeries: a randomized controlled trial study
pmc-12492761.creator: Majid Bagheri, Morteza Shiryani, Sara Mehralizade, Mohammad Hasan Basirinezhad, Hossein Bagheri, Ali Abbasi
pmc-12492761.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionLearning skills in a clinical setting is one of the most desirable methods of education in medical sciences. Using a surgical preference card is an effective method in the clinical education of operating room nursing students.

pmc-12504145.title: First Report of Intervertebral Disc Calcification in a Black Child in Sub‐Saharan Africa
pmc-12504145.creator: Yamyelle Enselme Zongo, Ismael Ayouba Tinni, Hamiidah Hunsu‐Horhon Guingani, Yannick Laurent Tchenadoyo Bayala, Aboubakar Ouedraogo, Fulgence Kabore, Wendlassida Stéphanie Joelle Zabsonré/Tiendrebeogo, Dieu‐Donné Ouedraogo
pmc-12504145.description: We report an intervertebral disc calcification in a Black African child who had consulted us for neck pain. The diagnosis of C2–C3 intervertebral disc calcification was made on a standard X‐ray and CT scan. Treatment was exclusively conservative. Intervertebral disc calcifications in children are rare and benign, requiring long‐term monitoring.

pmc-13105271.title: Evaluating Targeted Recruitment Interventions and Outcomes to Measure Diversity in Emergency Medicine: A Scoping Review
pmc-13105271.creator: Sherell Hicks, Erin F Shufflebarger, Zachary Pacheco, James Gilbreath, Logan Wilson, Christopher Reisig, Teresa M Chan
pmc-13105271.description: As the US national population continues to diversify, there have been access and engagement efforts within emergency medicine (EM) to help create a workforce that is more representative of the patients we treat. While the importance of diversity is well recognized, there has not been an established way to measure the effectiveness of diversity interventions beyond demographics.

pmc-13284026.title: Orchid bee diversity responds positively to forest cover and landscape heterogeneity in the Brazilian Savanna
pmc-13284026.creator: Fernanda G de Sousa, Leonardo L Bergamini, Milena F Diniz, Paulo De M Júnior, Rosane G Collevatti, Daniel P Silva

pmc-13376859.title: Assessment of potential nephrotoxicity biomarkers after [177Lu]Lu-DOTA-(Tyr3)-octreotate administration and effects of antioxidant α1-microglobulin
pmc-13376859.creator: Charlotte Ytterbrink, Daniella Pettersson, Emman Shubbar, Khalil Helou, Martin E. Johansson, Eva Forssell-Aronsson
pmc-13376859.description: Patients with neuroendocrine tumours may receive higher total amount of [177Lu]Lu-DOTA-(Tyr3)-octreotate and achieve better tumor control if the risk of kidney toxicity could be predicted individually for each patient. One strategy for such a prediction includes the evaluation of early responding biomarkers for kidney damage during treatment to decide the number of treatment cycles.

pmc-13414663.title: Hiding in Plain Sight: HIV-1 Membraneless Organelles as Nuclear Hubs—Host Hijacking, Replication, Immune Evasion, and Drug-Access Implications
pmc-13414663.creator: Francesco Broccolo, Alessandro Sannino, Mauro Pollini, Federica Paladini, Thierry Mourer, Francesca Di Nunzio
pmc-13414663.description: Theories on the early steps of the HIV-1 life cycle have been radically revised over the past five years. The long-held assumption that the capsid fully disassembles in the cytoplasm has given way to a more nuanced view: Cytoplasmic disassembly does occur and, in several myeloid systems, is increasingly linked to cytosolic cDNA sensing and to abortive infection.

pmc-13426284.title: Reducing Rates of Cesarean Delivery in Rural US Communities: A Systematic Review of Interventions and Approaches to Care
pmc-13426284.creator: Jena L. Funakoshi, Hannah M. Collins-Doijode, Kathryn L. Braun

pmc-13494021.title: Consequences of agricultural deforestation and subsequent afforestation on soil biodiversity and ecosystem multifunctionality
pmc-13494021.creator: Zhi Yu, Kerong Zhang, Xiao-min Zeng, Xiaoli Cheng, Yulong Zhang, Xia Wang, Junhui Sun, Liangqi Chen, Feng Liu, Quanfa Zhang
pmc-13494021.description: The Earth is currently in an era where massive deforestation and afforestation coexist. The impact of large-scale agricultural deforestation and the subsequent afforestation on soil biota multidiversity, ecosystem multifunctionality (EMF), and the relationship between soil biota multidiversity and EMF (BEFm) remain unclear.

pmc-13543798.title: EGFR-Mutant Non–Small Cell Lung Cancer With Small Cell Transformation: Clinicopathological Features, Treatment Landscape, and Biomarker Profiles
pmc-13543798.creator: Chi-Lu Chiang, Ying-Ting Liao, Yi-Chen Yeh, Ruei-Lin Sun, Hsu-Ching Huang, Yung-Hung Luo, Chia-I Shen, Heng-Sheng Chao, Yen-Han Tseng, Tsu-Hui Shiao, Ruihong Wang, Haitao Wang, David S. Schrump, Yuh-Min Chen
pmc-13543798.description: IntroductionTransformed small-cell lung cancer (tSCLC) is a clinically important resistance mechanism to EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors in EGFR-mutant non–small cell lung cancer. This study characterizes clinical features, treatment outcomes, and biomarker profiles in patients with tSCLC.MethodsData from 45 patients with EGFR-mutant NSCLC who developed tSCLC between 2014 and 2023 were analyzed.

pmc-13677767.title: Sperm-TLR2 activation enhances bovine embryo developmental competence via modulation of intracellular calcium and autophagic flux
pmc-13677767.creator: Taiyo HASHIMOTO, Ihshan AKTHAR, Yu MATSUZAWA, Alireza MANSOURI, Ren UCHIYAMA, Fumie MAGATA, Akio MIYAMOTO
pmc-13677767.description: The optimization of in vitro embryo production (IVP) is critical for bovine biotechnology, particularly for maximizing the yield of high-quality embryos suitable for transfer. This study investigated how Toll-like receptor 2 (TLR2) activation in sperm, using the agonist Pam3CSK4 (Pam), influences fertilization outcomes, metabolic activity, and cryotolerance.

uslaw-usc-t28-s956.title: 28 U.S.C. § 956 — Powers and duties of clerks and deputies
uslaw-usc-t28-s956.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t28-s956.description: United States Code, Title 28 (Judiciary And Judicial Procedure); Part III (Court Officers And Employees); Chapter 57 (General Provisions Applicable To Court Officers And Employees). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The clerk of each court and his deputies and assistants shall exercise the powers and perform the duties assigned to them by the court.

uslaw-usc-t42-s16511.title: 42 U.S.C. § 16511 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t42-s16511.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s16511.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 149 (National Energy Policy And Programs); Subchapter XV (Incentives For Innovative Technologies). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this subchapter: (1) Commercial technology (A) In general The term “commercial technology” means a technology in general use in the commercial marketplace. (B) Inclusions The term “commercial technology” does not include a technology.
